cases.title: Add safe discounts to the typed cart
cases.objective: The TypeScript cart currently totals positive integer cent amounts. Add a percentage discount argument without losing integer-cent accounting. [discount] Percentages 0 through 100 inclusive are valid; floor the final discounted total, so [101,100] at 25 percent yields 150. Reject fractional, negative, or above-100 percentages. [regression] Keep the default discount zero, retain existing item validation, and extend the executable assertions and types. Keep this a small local TypeScript change; do not introduce services, network access, new dependencies, or a generalized pricing engine.

criteria.text: A 25 percent discount on [101,100] returns 150 cents; invalid discount inputs throw.
Existing item guards and default behavior remain executable alongside discount assertions.

cases.title: Extend the generated status catalog
cases.objective: The status catalog is generated from data/status.json. [catalog] Add status paused with label Waiting and rank 2, preserving ready rank 1. [regenerate] Regenerate generated/status.mjs from its source and retain deterministic lexical key order and a stale-output check. Update assertions for the new status. The generator owns its output: no output-only hand edits. Keep one small generator and offline Node checks; no new generator framework or package dependencies.

criteria.text: Source data contains ready rank 1 and paused Waiting rank 2, with generator support.
Generated output matches the generator byte for byte and exports both status records.

cases.title: Add a bounded WebAssembly answer export
cases.objective: This repository contains a real, tiny WebAssembly module and its byte generator. [module] Extend scripts/module.mjs to generate a valid module exporting answer() -> i32 with value 42. [artifact] Regenerate assets/answer.wasm and extend check.mjs to instantiate the actual binary and assert answer() returns 42. Keep the artifact below 1024 bytes, non-LFS, reproducible, and owned by the generator; preserve WebAssembly validation and do not add a compiler download, remote service, secret, or external dependency.

criteria.text: The byte generator defines a valid answer function returning the i32 value 42.
The actual regenerated non-LFS module instantiates, returns 42, and remains below 1024 bytes.

cases.title: Bound deterministic queue simulation admission
cases.objective: The offline queue simulator currently admits every arrival. [capacity] Add an explicit positive-integer capacity option and admit only up to capacity arrivals, with deterministic admitted/rejected counts. With seed 7, four ticks, and capacity 2, arrivals remain [3,1,3,2], admitted are [2,1,2,2], and rejected are [1,0,1,0]. [replay] Preserve repeatability for equal seeds, preserve existing arrival generation, reject invalid capacity, and extend executable assertions. Do not use timing, randomness from the host, network, or real queue services.

criteria.text: Capacity two yields admitted [2,1,2,2] and rejected [1,0,1,0] for seed seven.
Repeat seeds produce identical bounded-admission traces and invalid capacity is rejected.

cases.title: Make paused status visible without color alone
cases.objective: The status card is a deterministic SVG produced by a small renderer. [paused] Add paused state with visible text Paused and a double-bar icon, keeping ready state Ready with its checkmark. [snapshot] Refresh visual/status.svg for paused state and extend offline renderer assertions for text, shape, and width 160 height 48. Preserve the viewBox and accessible title. A reviewer must inspect the actual SVG at its intended size for unclipped readable text and the distinct icon; string checks alone do not establish visual quality. Keep deterministic offline SVG output, no browser automation framework or remote assets.

criteria.text: The renderer exposes paused text plus double bars while preserving ready semantics.
The rendered paused SVG remains accessible, readable and unclipped at 160 by 48.
